# i18n and accessibility

Builds on `frontend.instructions.md`. Terms/tone: `docs/glossary.md`.
Tokens: `docs/design-system.md`.

## i18n (EN + HI)

- Every user-facing string is a translation key (`next-intl`) in both
  `en.json` and `hi.json` — no hard-coded strings in components.
- Include new feature namespaces in the client provider's message projection;
  generated catalogs alone do not make those keys available to Client Components.
- Key naming: `<feature>.<screen>.<element>` (e.g.
  `checkout.address.addLabel`); reuse keys across screens instead of
  duplicating near-identical copy.
- All numbers/money/dates/distances/phones go through
  `packages/shared` formatters (INR paise -> `₹1,25,000` with Indian
  grouping, UTC -> IST 12-hour) — never format inline.
- **Long-Hindi rule:** Hindi strings run 30-60% longer than English.
  Components must wrap/reflow; never fixed-width truncate a status,
  button, or label. Test every new screen with its Hindi strings, not
  just English.
- Hindi content only appears in `en.json`/`hi.json` catalogs and
  reviewed microcopy (`docs/glossary.md`) — never invented inline.

## WCAG 2.2 AA

- Colour contrast AA minimum; **status is never colour-only** — always
  icon + text (order/approval statuses, `docs/design-system.md`).
- All interactive elements reachable and operable by keyboard; visible
  3px focus ring; logical tab order; skip-to-content link.
- Proper ARIA roles/labels on custom components (combobox, tabs,
  carousel, dialog); live regions for toasts/async updates.
- Reduced motion: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — disable
  autoplay/parallax/carousel auto-advance, keep functional transitions
  only.
- Dark mode uses the dark token set (`docs/design-system.md`), not an
  inverted-filter hack; verify contrast in both themes.

## Keyboard patterns

- **Dialog/sheet:** focus trap on open, focus returns to trigger on
  close, Esc closes only the top-most layer
  (`frontend.instructions.md`).
- **Combobox:** Arrow keys move options, Enter selects, Esc closes,
  type-ahead filters; announce result count changes.
- **Tabs:** Arrow keys move between tabs, Home/End jump to first/last;
  only the active tab panel is in the tab order.
- **Carousel/media carousel (PD2):** arrow keys prev/next, Home/End
  jump, pinch/double-tap zoom has a keyboard equivalent (zoom
  buttons), full-screen viewer traps focus.
- **Reels (RL):** up/down arrow keys move between videos on desktop;
  space/Enter toggles play/pause; all overlay actions
  (follow/like/comment/share) are keyboard-reachable.

## Checklist for new screens/components

1. All strings are translation keys present in both catalogs?
2. Tested with Hindi strings for overflow/wrapping?
3. Status shown with icon + text, not colour alone?
4. Fully keyboard-operable with visible focus?
5. `prefers-reduced-motion` respected?
6. Verified in light and dark themes?
